items.reason: In D-013's main view, the vertical centreline is X=0 and the horizontal centreline is Y=0 (it splits the 25,0 height). M5 pair: callout p1-1 gives 2 x Ø4,2 THRU ALL M5 - 6H. The left 82,0 (n/82.0@1-1, box ~x489pt) runs from the left M5 hole to the centreline, and the right M5 hole sits in the opposed mirrored position. 4,5 (n/4.5@1-1) locates both on the axis above Y=0. So x=0-n0=-82 and a 2-count row with spacing n0*2=164 along 0° is correct. M3 holes: n/17.9@1-1 runs from the centreline extension to the first hole right of centre. n/35.7@1-1 runs from that hole to the next one, so x=17.9 and x=n0+n1=53.6 are directly dimensioned. 7,5 (n/7.5@1-1) runs from Y=0 to the lower hole axis, so y=-7.5. The Ø2,5 THRU ALL M3 - 6H values come from p1-2. Slots: callout p1-3 gives 4 x 5,5 X 10,0 THRU ALL. 41,0 (n/41.0@1-1) runs from the centreline to the inner right slot, and the right 82,0 (n/82.0@1-2) runs from there to the outer right slot. The left slots mirror these, so a uniform 82 pitch from -123 gives -123,-41,41,123; this matches 41+41=82 across the centre. The slot long axes are drawn vertical. 2,3 (n/2.3@1-1) runs from Y=0 to the lower arc centre of the right slot, which is marked with crosshairs. That gives a slot centre of n0+(n1-n2)/2=4.55, and the slot bottom at -0.45 sits just below the centreline, matching the view. Numeric values, cited IDs, expressions and ordering (holes by x ascending, then slots) are all consistent.

The design is not complete. Six of the eight M3 holes from callout p1-2 are left out of features. The four outer corner clips in D-013's main view have no setback dimensions. The edge-break note (general/edge_finish) gives no geometry. So false is correct.

The main view of D-013 shows straight clips at all four outer corners, with no setback or 45° chamfer callout. The DEBURR AND BREAK SHARP EDGES note gives no size. Only the two holes right of centre are dimensioned (17,9 and the following 35,7). The other six hole positions in the 8 x M3 callout are not printed one by one. 2×17,9=35,8 does not equal 35,7, so it is right not to extend a uniform pitch or mirror the holes into guessed coordinates. The main, end and isometric views show no other blind holes, side holes, counterbores, countersinks or recesses. Each omission cites the correct source IDs.
